data.name: Compliance Auditor
data.detailed_description:
“In the world of ultra-corporations, the greatest threat isn't a market crash—it’s an unfavorable report.”

The Premise

Welcome to PsyOps Global, the sprawling, mile-high headquarters of the world’s largest conglomerate. You are a Senior Compliance Auditor, dispatched by the Global Regulatory Commission. On paper, your job is to review tax records and safety protocols. In reality, PsyOps Global hasn't allowed an auditor to leave the building in twelve years.

Equipped with a "Regulatory Enforcement Suit" and a ledger that doubles as a tactical HUD, you must navigate the distorted corridors of the facility to uncover the truth behind their "Infinite Growth" initiative.

Gameplay and Progression

Your primary objective is to eliminate audit failure manifestations—corporate archive records that have breached reality and taken the shape of monstrous entities.

  • Character Growth: Engage in a robust level-up based system that rewards your performance by unlocking an arsenal of new weapons.

  • Expansion & Crafting: Successfully overcoming challenges will grant access to new levels, unique enemies, powerful items, and a crafting system, all of which will be significantly expanded in upcoming content updates.

  • Game Modes: Beyond the core campaign, look forward to additional challenges including high-octane Time Attack and Wave-based survival modes arriving in future updates.

Join the Development

We believe in the power of community. We would love for you to provide feedback as you play, as we intend to incorporate your suggestions directly into our ongoing game development. Join the conversation and help shape the future of PsyOps Global!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-8100 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / RX 560 / Intel UHD 630
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 580 / RTX 2060
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a mature, extremely graphic game containing frequent intense violence, gore, adult themes, and general mature content, including non-graphic cartoon/fantasy violence.
